Question: A set of teams held a round-robin tournament in which every team played every other team exactly once. Every team won \(10\) games and lost \(10\) games; there were no ties. How many sets of three teams \(\{A,B,C\}\) were there in which \(A\) beat \(B,\) \(B\) beat \(C,\) and \(C\) beat \(A?\)
